Language: English 简体中文 日本語 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 A mobile GUI agent framework for Android. 
 

 
 OpenGUI helps AI agents see, understand, and operate Android app interfaces on real devices.
 

 
 Use OpenGUI in WorkBuddy or DeepSeek Harness. 
 Install the plugin, connect your phone, and describe your task. No full backend deployment is required.
 

 Features at a Glance

OpenGUI uses real screenshots to understand apps and carry out phone operations and testing tasks from natural-language instructions.

- Phone operations : open apps, tap, swipe, type, navigate back, and move between screens to complete multi-step workflows.
- App testing : check features and workflows, record issues with reproduction steps and screenshots, and summarize results.
- Content and information : read screen content, organize information, fill forms, and prepare social media drafts.
- Visible execution : use the WorkBuddy workbench to view the phone screen, task steps, and reports, or take over and stop a task.
- Host integration : use OpenGUI in WorkBuddy or DeepSeek Harness; the DSH plugin also supports managed browser operations.

 Meet CoreMate

 The AI workforce for social media and growth teams. Scale outreach and follow-ups across many accounts and cloud phones, without adding headcount.

CoreMate puts AI agents to work in real mobile apps. They tap, type, read screens, send messages, and record results, running on Android cloud phones that we host, update, and maintain for you .

Describe your goal in plain language. CoreMate turns it into a step-by-step plan your team can review, then executes it in parallel across as many cloud phones as you need.

Try CoreMate through the Core-Mate.

 Common Commands

After installation and authorization, enter these instructions in the corresponding host's chat. Replace [placeholders] with your task details.

 Purpose Host Example input 
 --- --- --- 
 Open OpenGUI WorkBuddy /opengui 
 Check connected devices WorkBuddy /opengui List connected devices without operating a phone. 
 Operate a phone WorkBuddy /opengui Open Settings, then return to the home screen. Stop after confirming it is visible. 
 Test an app WorkBuddy /opengui Test [feature or workflow] in [app/page]. Record issues, steps, and screenshots. Stop at [end condition]. 
 Prepare a Tiktok draft WorkBuddy /opengui Prepare a Tiktok image-and-text draft about [topic]. Stop before publishing. 
 Run a task in DSH DeepSeek Harness @OpenGUI Open Settings and report the Android version 

 Use OpenGUI in WorkBuddy

Supported on macOS (Apple Silicon / Intel) with WorkBuddy 5.5.3 or later . The current public release is 0.4.2, a public-testing prerelease. China and international WorkBuddy use the same OpenGUI package and version. Custom MCP installation is available without a connector marketplace listing.

OpenGUI and WorkBuddy accounts are separate. OpenGUI SMS sign-in currently requires a mainland-China phone number ; signing into international WorkBuddy with Google/GitHub does not sign you into OpenGUI.

 [!IMPORTANT]
 Restart WorkBuddy once after installation. Finish other tasks, fully quit with ⌘Q , then reopen WorkBuddy before authorizing OpenGUI. Closing its window is not enough.

 Step 1. Install with a Terminal command 

Open macOS Terminal and run the command for your WorkBuddy edition. If you use both editions, install into each one separately. Complete the remaining steps in the edition selected here.

 China edition — WorkBuddy.app 

 

 International edition — WorkBuddy AI.app 

 

These commands explicitly select the target application, so having both editions installed will not cause OpenGUI to be installed into the wrong one. If your application is elsewhere or has been renamed, replace the path after --app with its actual path. The script downloads and verifies the installation files, prepares the runtime, and configures OpenGUI.

The China command uses npmmirror for Node and npm dependencies with official fallback; the international command uses official sources. To use official sources with China WorkBuddy, change --download-source cn to --download-source official . This setting applies only to this installation. Video assets use GitHub separately; an npm mirror does not accelerate them. See download source options for a custom video mirror.

You can also download install.sh separately and run bash /actual/path/install.sh with the same --app and --download-source arguments shown above.

See international installation and account limitations, or the GitHub installation flow (Chinese) for a copyable WorkBuddy prompt, native authorization and connection verification.

 Step 2. Restart WorkBuddy once 

After the installer finishes, complete other WorkBuddy tasks, fully quit with ⌘Q , and reopen WorkBuddy to load the newly installed MCP configuration.

 Step 3. Authorize the Skill and connector 

- China edition : authorize and enable OpenGUI under 专家·技能·连接器 → 技能 . Then open 连接器 → 自定义连接器 , find opengui , complete the trust prompt, and enable it.
- International edition : authorize and enable OpenGUI under Experts · Skills · Connectors → Skills . Then open Connectors → Custom connectors , click Trust for opengui , and enable it.

If an update triggers another Trust prompt, review and confirm it yourself.

 Both the Skill and connector require authorization. 

 

If OpenGUI is not listed under Connectors, check Custom connectors for its MCP service. If the authorization page did not open automatically, open the AUTHORIZATION GUIDE path printed in Terminal; no reinstallation is needed.

 Step 4. Verify the connection and start using OpenGUI 

You can first ask WorkBuddy: “Call opengui list devices once to verify the connection, report the device count, and do not operate a phone.” A successful call returning zero devices also confirms the plugin connection.

To start a phone task:

1. Enable USB debugging on your Android phone, connect it to your computer, and allow debugging on the pho
